heat-belt.name: WarmCore Belly Comfort Belt
heat-belt.blurb: A rechargeable, adjustable heat belt with gentle vibration, made for hands-free warmth on the lower belly or back during cramps and bloated days.

castor-kit.name: Castor Oil Pack Kit
castor-kit.blurb: A reusable organic cotton wrap with 2 oz of cold-pressed castor oil, for a calm, warm belly ritual. For use on the skin only.

ritual-set.name: The Belly Comfort Ritual Set
ritual-set.blurb: The WarmCore belt and the castor oil pack kit together, for an evening wind-down ritual.
